_comment: Single source of truth for gosec. package.json preflight:go and preflight:secscan both pass -conf .gosec.json. Do NOT re-add -exclude on the command line: it overrides this list.

_rationale.G104: Unhandled errors — reviewed by go vet and explicit error handling; errcheck noise.
_rationale.G115: Integer conversion overflow — conversions are bounded by validated input.
_rationale.G404: Weak random (math/rand) — used for non-cryptographic jitter/IDs only; secrets use crypto/rand.
_rationale.G702: Tainted command injection — deploy component executes user-declared build commands by design.
_rationale.G703: Tainted path — deploy/storage paths are validated against their configured roots.
_rationale.G704: SSRF — outbound targets come from operator-configured deploy settings, not request input.
_rationale.G112: Slowloris — timeouts are configured at the proxy/http.Server layer.
_rationale.G114: net/http server without timeouts — server construction sets Read/Write/Idle timeouts.
_rationale.G118: Goroutine context/cancel — long-lived workers intentionally use a background context.
_rationale.G120: Decompression bomb — upload/archive size limits are enforced before decompression.
_rationale.G124: Insecure TLS options — self-signed/insecure mode is opt-in for local development only.
_rationale.G204: Subprocess with variable — deploy runner executes declared commands; args are passed as a slice, not a shell string.
_rationale.G301: File permission > 0750 — storage directories are intentionally group-readable.
_rationale.G304: File path from variable — storage paths are validated and confined to the data root.
_rationale.G306: File permission > 0600 — generated config/docs are intentionally world-readable (0644).
_rationale.G705: XSS via tainted data — React escapes by default; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML on tainted input.
_rationale.G710: Open redirect — redirect targets are validated/allowlisted.
